subject: Social Media
title: The Pratfall Effect
description: Learn The Pratfall Effect in one minute.

hook.text: A polished brand post gets ignored. A CEO trips on camera and goes viral. Imperfection sells.

buildup.text: The pratfall effect: competent people become more likeable after a small mistake. It signals humanity.

discovery.text: Psychologist Elliot Aronson proved this in 1966. The expert who spilled coffee was rated most likeable.

twist.text: Brands learned this. 'Authentic' content—raw, messy, unfiltered—outperforms polished production.

climax.text: But manufactured imperfection backfires. Audiences detect staged vulnerability instantly now.

punchline.text: Be real or be ignored. There's no middle.

quiz.question: What is the pratfall effect?
options: Mistakes make competent people more likeable
